# Competitor And Demand Analysis

## When to use
Use when the task requires compare competitor offers, demand evidence, public prices, customer frustrations and differentiation.

## Procedure
Build fair comparison across similarly scoped offerings; label market signals vs demonstrated purchase intent; validate claims on public primary pages; note sample-size limitations and conflicts. Output competitor matrix, gaps, reversible positioning tests.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
